name: Lost Signal
source:
A short NSFW Visual Novel about getting stuck in the middle of the mountain during a blizzard with no signal.

[Edited from [url=https://johannofart.itch.io/lost-signal]itch.io[/url]]

一部不适合在工作场合阅读的短篇视觉小说。暴风雪把你困在半山腰，那里一点信号也没有。
